mapper.insert: INSERT INTO issue_attachments (issue_id, original_name, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, uploaded_by, context, comment_id) VALUES (#{issueId}, #{originalName}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{uploadedBy}, #{context}, #{commentId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, issue_id, original_name, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, uploaded_by, created_at, context, comment_id FROM issue_attachments WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND comment_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, issue_id, original_name, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, uploaded_by, created_at, context, comment_id FROM issue_attachments WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND comment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
